title: Install and retain a drive under a gravity-closing lid
instruction: Install the blue drive carrier in the chassis, insert the orange retaining bar, and leave the lid closed with both arms clear.
context: Service access and retention are coupled: the lid closes under gravity, capped rails require horizontal entry, and closing the lid captures the retaining bar. The fixture represents nonenergized enclosure maintenance.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; x forward, y left, z up; metres/kg/radians; XYZW quaternions. Tabletop z=0.7475 m. Fixed layout, seed 0, no object jitter. Each object below is an authored rigid body or cable-chain link; dimensions are collision envelopes. Shapes, local offsets, colors and joints are fully enumerated in scene.json. chassis: aluminium, 0.9 kg, envelope (0.22, 0.18, 0.06) m, origin (0.3, 0, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). lid: rigid aluminium proxy, 0.67 kg, envelope (0.208, 0.247, 0.067) m, origin (0.4, 0, 0.8115), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). drive: aluminium carrier with plastic handle, 0.22 kg, envelope (0.11, 0.082, 0.037) m, origin (0.22, -0.24, 0.7557), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). retainer: rigid engineering plastic, 0.06 kg, envelope (0.018, 0.095, 0.016) m, origin (0.36, -0.23, 0.7557), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). Two 18 by 16 by 26 mm underside ribs capture the bar when the lid closes.
scoring: 0.333333 for carrier_seated; 0.333333 for carrier_retained; 0.333333 for enclosure_closed. Each goal requires all numeric predicates in SCORING.md and scene.json. Credit is recomputed, so dislodged components lose credit. Full score also requires all bodies <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, robot clearance >=0.02 m, continuously for 1.0 s; otherwise score is capped at 0.95. Invalid frames, lost parts, fixture motion, broken preservation constraints, joint-limit violations or penetration >0.002 m permanently score zero.
run_limit: 3600 control actions at 20 Hz (180 simulated seconds maximum)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the authored layout and zero joint coordinates, settles through the official adapter, clears scorer history, and records a new episode. Native probes compare two reset repetitions within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Rigid compound collision shapes model a service enclosure, capped rails and a lid-captured retaining bar. The lid is passive and gravity-loaded. Enlarged handles accommodate YAM jaws. Sheet-metal compliance and electrical connection are omitted. No snapping or task-state writes occur in the expert.
scores: NOT RUN: native physics, expert demonstrations and Dream-1 evaluation have not been executed.
